svg.title: Pair plot of four battery-cell properties by chemistry
svg.desc: A scatterplot matrix (pair plot) of a fleet of lithium-ion battery cells from three chemistries: NMC-811 high-nickel, LFP iron-phosphate, and a fast-charging silicon-anode cell. The four measured properties crossed in the grid are usable energy density, fast-charge time, internal resistance, and rated cycle life. Off-diagonal cells are scatter plots where each chemistry has its own hue and marker shape (circle, square, triangle) so the families stay apart for colour-blind and greyscale readers; diagonal cells show each property’s per-chemistry distribution as a density curve. On every pair the three chemistries form three separated clusters: silicon-anode is high-density and fast-charging but short-lived, LFP is the durable long-cycle-life workhorse, and NMC-811 sits between them, so one cell measurement is enough to identify the family
svg.text: Three battery chemistries, three clean clusters
Pair plot of four measured properties across a fleet of lithium-ion cells. The chemistries separate on every
pair, so one cell measurement tells the families apart. The diagonal shows each distribution
